# NestJS GraphQL root coverage fixture for the Go cutover gate (T1.2 audit).
#
# Generated by the T1.2 static audit against baseline
# dcbe563b917fde0927637121a91de2186d6177a4 (branch docs/go-cutover-readiness).
# The authority for the root names is apps/api/schema.gql, which is byte-for-byte
# identical to apps/api-go/internal/graphqlread/schema/schema.gql; the audit also
# cross-checked every name against the NestJS @Query/@Mutation/@Subscription
# decorators.
#
# Format: kind rootName switch package
#   kind      Query | Mutation | Subscription
#   rootName  field name of the SDL root type
#   switch    the API_GO_* switch whose "go" value makes cmd/api/main.go register
#             this root. Read sub-switches also require
#             API_GO_GRAPHQL_READ_MODE=go:
#             * API_GO_GRAPHQL_WORKSPACE_READ_MODE /
#               API_GO_GRAPHQL_SETTINGS_CRAWL_READ_MODE /
#               API_GO_GRAPHQL_NEWS_EVENTS_MODE / API_GO_GRAPHQL_KG_IMPACT_MODE /
#               API_GO_GRAPHQL_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_MODE / API_GO_NEWS_INDICATORS_MODE /
#               API_GO_GRAPHQL_CRAWL_METADATA_MODE / API_GO_ITEMS_READING_MODE
#             * API_GO_GRAPHQL_ITEMS_LIST_MODE also needs API_GO_ITEMS_READING_MODE=go
#             * API_GO_GRAPHQL_NEWS_EVENT_BRIEF_MODE also needs
#               API_GO_GRAPHQL_NEWS_EVENTS_MODE=go
#             * API_GO_GRAPHQL_SUBSCRIPTIONS_MODE also needs
#               GRAPHQL_SUBSCRIPTION_BUS=redis
#   package   Go package that contains the registration call
#
# A-class definition (the only class this gate covers): the root has a Go
# RegisterRoot/RegisterMutation/RegisterSubscription call site reachable from a
# switchable cmd/api/main.go branch. A means execution can be taken over by Go;
# it does not claim runtime or business completeness. The T1.2 audit found
# A = 138 (C = 0).
#
# Counts: Query 77, Mutation 57, Subscription 4, total 138.
#
# Update procedure: when apps/api/schema.gql gains or loses a root field, re-run
# the T1.2 audit against the new origin/main, regenerate this list in SDL order
# (Query, then Mutation, then Subscription), and update the counts above. The Go
# test TestCutoverGraphQLRootFixtureMatchesSDL fails until this fixture and the
# embedded SDL agree again, and
# TestCutoverGraphQLRootsRegisteredInAllGoRegistry fails until every listed root
# is registered by the all-go registry.
